This is a list of auction and personnel signings for the [[2027 SA20]] cricket tournament.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/sa20-2027-sunrisers-eastern-cape-sign-mitchell-marsh-for-next-season-1548744|title=SA20: Sunrisers Eastern Cape sign Mitch Marsh; Joburg leave out du Plessis, Tahir|access-date=5 August 2026|work=ESPNcricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/mitchell-marsh-joins-root-curran-salt-in-star-studded-season-5-squad-reveal
|title=Mitchell Marsh joins Root, Curran & Salt in star-studded Season 5 squad reveal
|website=Betway SA20
|access-date=5 August 2026
}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/big-names-on-show-at-betway-sa20-season-5-player-auction|title=Big names on show at Betway SA20 Season 5 Player Auction|access-date=1 October 2026|work=SA20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/140427/sa20-auction-pollard-rowles-headline-super-kings-buys|title=SA20 Auction: Pollard, Rowles headline Super Kings buys|access-date=7 October 2026|work=Cricbuzz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/sa20-auction-jsk-sign-kieron-pollard-jason-rowles-mict-pick-shimron-hetmyer-and-trent-boult-1557573|title=SA20 auction: JSK sign Pollard, Rowles; MICT pick Hetmyer and Boult|access-date=8 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref>

==Background==
A total of 789 players registered for the auction, with 156 shortlisted for the [[2027 SA20|SA20 Season 5]] auction, which will take place on 7 October.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehawk.in/news/sports/sa20-season-5-du-plessis-van-der-dussen-mulder-headline-player-auctions-shortlist|title=SA20 Season 5: Du Plessis, Van der Dussen, Mulder headline Player Auctions shortlist|access-date=1 October 2026|work=The Hawks}}</ref> The shortlist comprises 95 South African players and 61 overseas players. However, only 19 slots remain to be filled across the four teams participating in the auction, with [[Durban's Super Giants]] and [[Paarl Royals]] having already completed their 19-player squads.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://m.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/140353/du-plessis-van-der-dussen-among-156-players-shortlisted-for-sa20-auction|title=Du Plessis, van der Dussen among 156 players shortlisted for SA20 auction|access-date=1 October 2026|work=Cricbuzz}}</ref>

==Pre-auction squad arrangements==
=== Retained, pre-signed players and wildcard signings===
Following the conclusion of the retention and pre-signing window ahead of the [[2027 SA20]], franchises announced their retained and pre-signed players before the auction.<ref>{{Cite web
|url=https://m.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/139750/marsh-root-among-marquee-sa20-additions-du-plessis-released-by-jsk
|title=Marsh, Root among marquee SA20 additions; du Plessis released by JSK
|website=Cricbuzz
|access-date=5 August 2026
}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/season-5-squads|title=All the Season 5 squads as they stand|website=Betway SA20|access-date=5 August 2026}}</ref>

== Player auction ==
A total of 156 players (95 South Africa and 61 overseas) entered the auction pool, with only 19 open places (5 South Africa and  14 overseas slot).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/faf-du-plessis-trent-boult-and-kieron-pollard-in-sa20-mini-auction-shortlist-1556754|title=Faf du Plessis, Trent Boult and Kieron Pollard in SA20 mini-auction shortlist|access-date=1 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/live-blog/sa20-2027-auction-live-faf-du-plessis-kieron-pollard-imran-tahir-rassie-van-der-dussen-among-156-players-1557477|title=SA20 auction |access-date=7 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/legends-and-young-guns-light-up-betway-sa20-season-5-player-auction|title=Legends and young guns light up Betway SA20 Season 5 Player Auction |access-date=7 October 2026|work=SA20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.clubcricket.co.za/latestnews/sa20-player-auction-updates/|title=SA20 player auction recap > who joined, where, for how much?|access-date=7 October 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref>
